常见踩坑 ×7

① 等到 1,000 条数据才开始
→ 用少量分层数据先建闭环，再按失败模式扩展。
② 只看总体平均分
→ 看切片、严重程度和回归，不让平均分掩盖高风险失败。
③ 把 LLM Judge 当真值
→ 用人工校准 Judge，监控一致性、偏差和版本漂移。
④ 所有 Bad Case 都加入测试集
→ 去重、归因、标注，分流到 Dev / Regression / Holdout。
⑤ 只评最终答案
→ 同时评 Outcome 和 Trajectory，才能定位工具、规划和恢复问题。
⑥ 只做 Dashboard 不做 Gate
→ 指标必须连接到 Ship / Canary / Hold / Rollback。
⑦ Evaluation ≠ QA

QA 验证确定性软件是否满足规格；Agent Evaluation 测量概率系统在数据分布、轨迹、风险和业务结果上的表现——还需处理 Stochastic outputs · Judge uncertainty · Dataset evolution · Distribution shift · Model/Prompt drift。

项目映射 · 诚信表达

In AutodidactAgent, evaluation was tightly connected to the development loop because each case had an objective numeric target and a case-level score. That gave us a clear signal for whether a synthesized skill actually improved performance and whether the extra development cost was justified.

不要说搭建过完整企业 Evaluation Dashboard / 大规模生产 CI/CD / 全公司 LLM Judge 平台。更准确：I have implemented important evaluation components and objective case-level scoring. For a production platform, I would extend this into versioned datasets, trace storage, calibrated judges, release gates, and an online bad-case flywheel.

Seven Common Pitfalls

① Waiting until you have 1,000 examples before starting
→ Start the loop with a small stratified dataset, then expand by failure mode.
② Looking only at the overall average
→ Inspect slices, severity, and regressions so averages do not hide high-risk failures.
③ Treating the LLM Judge as ground truth
→ Calibrate the Judge with humans and monitor agreement, bias, and version drift.
④ Adding every Bad Case to the test set
→ Deduplicate, attribute root cause, label, and route cases into Dev / Regression / Holdout.
⑤ Evaluating only the final answer
→ Evaluate both Outcome and Trajectory to localize tool, planning, and recovery problems.
⑥ Building a Dashboard without a Gate
→ Metrics must connect to Ship / Canary / Hold / Rollback.
⑦ Evaluation ≠ QA

QA verifies whether deterministic software meets specifications; Agent Evaluation measures how aprobabilistic systemperforms across data distributions, trajectories, risks, and business outcomes—and must also handle Stochastic outputs · Judge uncertainty · Dataset evolution · Distribution shift · Model/Prompt drift.

Why did the task execute this way?

trajectory · tool choice · state change · evidence · recovery · outcome
TRACE vs TRAJECTORY

Trace = operational call graph. Trajectory = task-semantic execution record. They can share trace context without being the same concept.

FIG.9.G2 · GUARDRAIL EVIDENCE GATE

Spec + ChangeSet + Evidence → PASS / BLOCKED / UNKNOWN

RULE

GuardrailSpec@revision

Pins check objectives, decision criteria, and evidence requirements.
ACTION SNAPSHOT

immutable ChangeSet@digest

Freezes what is about to execute so the checked object cannot drift.
EVIDENCE

Agent Submission(s)

source · observation time · scope · result · failure reason
GATE

PASS · BLOCKED · UNKNOWN

UNKNOWN ≠ PASS. Insufficient evidence should hold or escalate, not relax the standard.
COMMIT

Executor revalidates current real-world state

permission · resource version · target · action · duplicate risk
Authority boundary

Evidence collection can be delegated; authority to commit remains with the control plane.
